description: This file defines the ProspectsViewDetail class, which extends the ViewDetail class to customize the display behavior in the context of prospect detail views within the SuiteCRM application. It includes logic to retrieve and assign lead name information if available.

classes.name: ProspectsViewDetail
classes.description: A view class responsible for rendering the detail view of a prospect, extending base view functionality to include lead name retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the prospect detail view, retrieving lead information if lead_id is set, and assigning it to the template.
